Hi {{lead.First Name:default= Friend}},
Thank you again for attending the Q4 Product Insights Open Forum last week. I hope you enjoyed hearing from our product managers who highlighted updates to our education solutions and provided an overview of our newly established partnership with GradGuard.
To help us continue to improve these sessions, we kindly ask that you take a few minutes to complete our feedback survey <[[https://flywire.zoom.us/survey/jExzQ5v8TGPfLa74ZgG7lVBFHSQMdCDgjs98rCi9HBFjnStQMZI.lpImonXFOt_fUiAq/view?id=HjDNzR9dQbqaX2tgzi6mGQ#/sharePreview]]>. Your insights will be invaluable as we plan future open forums. Complete the survey and enter the chance to win a $100 Amazon gift card.
